entities.name: Ángela Auad
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ángela Auad was an Argentine social activist. She worked with the Mothers of the Plaza de Mayo to locate victims of forced disappearance during the Dirty War. Because of her activism, she was kidnapped, tortured and murdered.
